description.zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间。格式为: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The end of the time range to filter jobs by creation time. The time must be in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` ISO 8601 format.
Filters the results by job ID.

description.zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记 (第一页没有)。
description.en: The token for the next page of results. Leave this empty for the first request. To retrieve the next page, pass the `NextPageToken` value from the previous response.

description.zh: 排序顺序。目前只支持两种：CreateTimeDesc: 按创建时间降序 和 CreateTimeAsc: 按创建时间升序
description.en: The sort order for the results. Valid values: `CreateTimeDesc` (descending by creation time) and `CreateTimeAsc` (ascending by creation time).
The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的起始时间。格式为: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start of the time range to filter jobs by creation time. The time must be in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` ISO 8601 format.

description.zh:
任务状态 
- Inited: 已提交, 
- Running: 执行中
- Complete: 完成, 
- Error: 错误。
description.en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

- `Inited`: The job has been submitted.

- `Running`: The job is running.

- `Complete`: The job is complete.

- `Error`: The job failed due to an error.

title.zh: 查询媒体转码任务列表
